key_insight: OrionMoE-Small is a compact tabular foundation model that uses dataset-aware sparse mixture-of-experts routing to improve in-context learning on heterogeneous tabular tasks without gradient-based adaptation.
engineering_relevance: The model offers a scalable design pattern for tabular AI systems by allocating computation selectively across features and datasets, making it attractive for efficient deployment on diverse real-world tabular workloads.
method: Dual-axis Transformer architecture for tabular in-context learning
Sparse MoE activated along the feature axis with routing informed by feature and dataset context
Pretrained on synthetic classification tasks generated from a structured causal prior
evidence_signal: Across multiple tabular benchmarks, the model matches or exceeds much larger foundation models, with especially strong performance on small-context, high-dimensional, and class-imbalanced datasets.
watch_item: Because pretraining relies entirely on synthetic classification tasks, transfer quality may depend on how well the synthetic causal prior matches the target data distribution.
paper_title: OrionMoE-v1.0: A Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Tabular In-Context Learning
